source.sql:
WITH u AS (
  SELECT i,
    (hash(i * 8 + 1) % 1000000)::DOUBLE / 1e6 AS u1,
    (hash(i * 8 + 2) % 1000000)::DOUBLE / 1e6 AS u2,
    (hash(i * 8 + 3) % 1000000)::DOUBLE / 1e6 AS u3,
    (hash(i * 8 + 4) % 1000000)::DOUBLE / 1e6 AS u4,
    (hash(i * 8 + 5) % 1000000)::DOUBLE / 1e6 AS u5
  FROM range(50000) t(i)
)
SELECT i AS id,
  TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' + to_seconds(floor(pow(u5, 0.7) * 2592000)::BIGINT) AS time,
  -180 + 360 * u1 AS longitude,
  30 * sin(radians(2 * (-180 + 360 * u1))) + (u2 - 0.5) * 24 AS latitude,
  round(least(-ln(u3 + 1e-6) * 1.1, 9.0), 2) AS mag,
  round(least(-ln(u3 + 1e-6) * 1.1, 9.0) * 35 + u4 * 80, 1) AS depth
FROM u

panels.title: Over time
panels.description: Brush to filter the other panels. Writes the variables t0 and t1.

options.spec:
params:
  brush: { select: crossfilter }
plot:
  - mark: rectY
    data: { from: quakes, filterBy: $brush }
    x: { bin: time }
    y: { count: }
    fill: steelblue
    inset: 0.5
  - select: intervalX
    as: $brush
marginLeft: 48
yLabel: null
xLabel: null
options.variables:
- param: brush
  column: time
  from: t0
  to: t1

panels.title: Where
panels.description: Density computed in DuckDB. Drag a box: it writes the variable area, as WKT.

options.spec:
params:
  brush: { select: crossfilter }
plot:
  - mark: raster
    data: { from: quakes, filterBy: $brush }
    x: longitude
    y: latitude
    fill: density
    pixelSize: 2
  - select: intervalXY
    as: $brush
xDomain: [-180, 180]
yDomain: [-60, 60]
colorScale: sqrt
colorScheme: magma
marginLeft: 40
options.variables:
- param: brush
  column: [longitude, latitude]
  variable: area

options.spec:
params:
  brush: { select: crossfilter }
input: table
from: quakes
filterBy: $brush
columns: [time, mag, depth, longitude, latitude]
width: { time: 170 }

panels.title: Read by Chaski SQL
panels.description: A plain Grafana table on Chaski: it follows the brushes through the variables they write.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*)::DOUBLE AS quakes, round(avg(mag), 2) AS "mean magnitude", round(avg(depth), 1) AS "mean depth"
FROM $quakes
WHERE $__crossfilter($quakeFilters)

panels.title: Filters
panels.description: Chaski's list of the active filters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT label, value FROM $__filters($quakeFilters) WHERE active
